about_the_game:
Cooperation. Looting. Survival.

In the depths of a ruined galaxy, laws no longer exist. The great factions have collapsed, giving way to cosmic chaos where only cunning, strength, and cooperation can ensure survival.

You play as a Void Raider, a free-roaming space scavenger ready to risk everything to seize rare resources and forgotten artifacts.

You are not alone, several enemy factions are unleashing their forces against you:

  • Mutants born from uncontrolled experiments

  • Aliens with unpredictable behavior

  • Robotic security, drones, and heavily armed autonomous units

  • …and far worse.

 Choose your role, play as a team

Each player must choose a specialized role, purchasable in-game. Cooperate smartly to maximize your chances of survival:

  • Bandit: armed with a pistol, the group’s strike force, ready to engage in combat at the first sign of threat.

  • Navigator: equipped with a scanner, detects enemies, important objects, and traps before it’s too late.

  • Carrier: able to lift heavy objects with less penalty, essential for recovering bulky treasures.

  • Hacker: can hack systems, disable machines, and open doors requiring access cards or codes.

Or choose to remain a Raider: versatile, it has no special abilities but benefits from an additional inventory slot, ideal for carrying more resources.

Each role complements the others. Victory belongs to teams that communicate, adapt, and support each other.

Game Modes

• Main Mode: Expeditions

The heart of the game.
Explore, search, and loot hostile environments to bring back resources, valuable items, and rare artifacts.

Everything you extract can be sold to purchase:

  • better equipment,

  • character upgrades,

  • robots that allow dead players to continue playing,

  • a mule to carry more loot,

  • and many other essential upgrades for survival.

The higher the difficulty, the more valuable the rewards.
New items, rooms, enemies, and even a hidden high-level quest await the most daring players.

• Defense Mode

A mission where your team must protect an objective against waves of enemies.

Completing it reduces the maximum quota required to continue your expeditions, easing your progression.

• Breach Mode

A short but extremely difficult mission set in an unstable environment.

It does not count toward the quota, making it a great opportunity to take risks without harming your overall progress.

Perfect for earning a lot of money quickly especially if you manage to find the map’s treasure chest.

Procedurally Generated Levels

All levels except Defense Mode are procedurally generated, ensuring a fresh experience on every run.

Death, Permadeath & Save Reset

In all game modes Expeditions, Breach, and Defense the rule is the same:

If the entire team dies, the run ends instantly.

Your expedition progress, carried resources, and completed objectives are lost.

Your save is reset, forcing you to start again from the beginning.

Plan, Survive, Make It Back Alive

Plan as a team: Up to 4 players can cooperate in the raid. Coordinate and survive together or not at all.

But beware: every expedition is a risk. If you fall, you lose everything… unless your teammates manage to make it out.

  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti
  • DirectX: Version 11
